message.reasoning:
My cash is low at $45, and p3 only has Oriental so far—getting Vermont wouldn't complete their monopoly since p1 holds Connecticut. Selling Vermont for its $120 value would help my cash, but it's my only leverage for prying Illinois away from p3, who probably won't trade it for Vermont anyway.

Since I can't afford a cash add-on, maybe I throw in Water Works alongside Vermont for Illinois—utilities aren't worth much and completing the reds would be a big long-term win even if I can't build right away. Worst case p3 rejects, but with plenty of exchanges allowed I'll go ahead and counter with Vermont plus Water Works for Illinois.
